description: This source file implements a CLI command using Cobra to stop an agent node in the AgentField system. It provides functions to gracefully shutdown the agent process via HTTP or signal, and updates the local registry accordingly.

classes.name: AgentNodeStopper
classes.description: A struct responsible for stopping agent nodes and managing the registry

methods.name: StopAgentNode
methods.description: Stops a running agent node, attempting HTTP shutdown first, falling back to process signals, then updating the registry

methods.name: loadRegistry
methods.description: Loads the agent installation registry from file

methods.name: saveRegistry
methods.description: Saves the current state of the agent installation registry to file
